changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE job ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), type varchar(50) NOT NULL, status varchar(20) NOT NULL, phase varchar(20), params jsonb, total_files integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, processed_files integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, screenshots_created integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cancel_requested boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, error text, started_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_activity_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), finished_at timestamp ); CREATE INDEX job_type_status_idx ON job (type, status);
